module "FunctionSwizzleNotSelection.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiFunctionSwizzle" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Constant(Value=(1, 0.5, 0.25)) : float3 @L12:C23 "Color"
  %1 = Custom[Shade](color=%0, Code="// Begin DreamShader source: <corpus>/Legacy/IR/Rules/FunctionSwizzleNotSelection.dsm\n// DreamShader custom: Shade line 2\n return color * 0.5; \n// End DreamShader source: <corpus>/Legacy/IR/Rules/FunctionSwizzleNotSelection.dsm\n", Description="Shade", OutputType="Float3") : [Result:float3] @L12:C17 "Color"
  %2 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="z") : float @L12:C17 "Color"
  %3 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="y") : float @L12:C17 "Color"
  %4 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="x") : float @L12:C17 "Color"
  %5 = Append(%2, %3) : float2 @L12:C17 "Color"
  %6 = Append(%5, %4) : float3 @L12:C17 "Color"
  %7 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%6) @L4:C1
  sink %7
